notes.title: Version 1.2.2 Release - Wednesday 4/16
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43952404/8ca8e4c760b39415e544d4ef0090789abbb78483.png[/img]
[i]...Fenrir has managed to escape from Asgard and decides to unleash his full wrath upon Midgard, quickly wiping out every living being in that world. The warrior gods, overwhelmed by the situation, decide to ally and fight one last battle against the great wolf, managing to win and restore peace to Midgard...[/i]

[b][h1]Version 1.2.2 Release[/h1][/b]

On Wednesday, April 16 (Before Easter in Argentina) at 8:00 PM UTC -3, version 1.2.2 of AESIR Online will be released. This consists of a complete reset of characters and items.

Regarding 1.2.1, it will include all the bug fixes recently made in that version and will add:

[list]
[*] New experience curve between levels 30 and 39.
[*] Asgard quests will now grant experience upon completion.
[*] Improvements to quest completion requirements.
[*] New starting balance for all classes.
[*] Reduction in the cost of crafting equipment and materials.
[*] New stable with a display of purchasable mounts.
[*] New custom faces.
[*] New mounts (including the Aesir Cloud and Lightning Cloud).
[*] More and better item descriptions.
[*] New quests.
[/list]

We look forward to seeing you all!
[b]AESIR Online[/b] Team

notes.title: Opening version 1.2
notes.notes:
[h2][b]AESIR ONLINE[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43952404/8f50d6cdd4ba32976103bdf4f6f146307c3543c9.png[/img]

Next December 1st at 8:00 p.m. (GMT-3) will be the opening of version 1.2 of the game. This version includes updates of all kinds with respect to the version that precedes it.


Keep in mind that the release of version 1.2 also includes a reset of all characters in the world (accounts will remain created).

Nevertheless, [b]The game is now available for download on this platform.[/b]
Keep in mind that many things are still in the testing stage or simply have not been added yet (such as translations from Spanish to English, game mechanics, new environments, etc.).

Don't forget to join our official discord to stay informed instantly: [b]https://discord.gg/7yXUf7NTXH[/b] 
or follow the social network link on our official page [b]https://aesir-online.com[/b]

[b]AESIR Online[/b] team.
